findings.source_quote: Ἄγωμεν, καὶ μετὰ ἡμέρας δύο ἔλθωμεν καὶ καθαρίσωμεν τοὺς λίθους τούτους, καὶ βάλωμεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομήν
findings.english_quote: Let us go. In two days we will return, clean these stones and put them into the building.
findings.issue: The source presents returning, cleaning, and placing the stones as coordinated exhortations. The simplified text changes these into a definite statement of future action, losing the shepherd’s proposal that they undertake these actions together.
findings.suggested_revision: For fresh review: “Let us go. After two days, let us return, clean these stones, and put them into the building.”

findings.source_quote: Κατανοήσωμεν τοὺς λίθους πάντας, καὶ ἴδωμεν τοὺς δυναμένους εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν ἀπελθεῖν.
findings.english_quote: Retain all seven stone conditions, the three strikes, the two-day interval, inside/outside placement, setting aside versus rejection and no-joint selection; preserve all substantive alternative notes.
findings.issue: This unit’s simplification metadata claims preservation of material not present in the selected section. The seven stone conditions, three strikes, and no-joint selection belong to surrounding sections; the supplied comparison report places the strike count in S.9.vi.3 and the no-joint selection in S.9.ix.7. This is an inaccurate local audit statement, rather than evidence of this edition’s coverage.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace this with a section-specific account of the distinctions actually preserved here: cleaning and fitting rejected stones, disposal of unsuitable stones, interior/exterior placement, the two-day interval, mandatory cleanup, and the consequences of the master’s unexpected arrival. If the existing statement is intended as a multi-section summary, label its scope and provide the relevant section references. Review the replacement afresh.

summary: The standard edition faithfully represents the selected working Greek, including its disclosed editorial supplement, necessity, and negative consequence. The simplified edition was reviewed independently and needs correction of the exhortations in paragraph 6 and its mis-scoped simplification metadata. Acceptance concerns only the supplied working source and reported evidence; it does not authenticate manuscripts or certify an exhaustive collation. Proposed corrections require fresh review.
